item.title: City of Isle of Palms to Host Hurricane & Resilience Expo
item.description: The City of Isle of Palms Recreation Department, Isle of Palms Fire Department and the LENS Foundation will team up to host a Hurricane & Resilience Expo on Thursday, May 7, 2026, from 4 to 7 p.m.

item.title: The Community Came Together for the Sweetheart Dance
item.description: On a magical evening at Sullivan’s Island Elementary School, the Sweetheart Dance bloomed into an enchanted garden where twinkling lights shimmered, music floated through the air, and the night swirled with joy.

item.title: Heart of Palms: Two Cars for Two Good Causes
item.description: Sometimes the most meaningful moments in a community arrive in unexpected ways. This winter, they happened to arrive on four wheels.

item.title: Two Artists, Two Paths, One Coast
item.description: The South Carolina coast is not just scenery. It is a force that shapes how artists see, work, and build a painting. For Chris Frick and Nadine O. Vogel, that force enters abstraction in distinct ways.

item.title: Pacific Legal Foundation Joins Legal Challenge to Defend Property Rights in South Carolina
item.description: Rom Reddy is continuing a legal fight to protect private property rights as government power increasingly encroaches on landowners across South Carolina.

item.title: The Isle of Palms Exchange “Needs Your Help”
item.description: The Isle of Palms Exchange Club Youth and Scholarship Program of Service will host its annual Oyster Roast on March 7 from 2 to 6 p.m. at the Exchange Club.

item.title: Lucky Dog: Blue
item.description: Yes, it’s your boy Blue here. Double the size of my littermates and made of nothing but love, intelligence and excellent hair. I was built to make a big impression — soft as a teddy bear, calm as a monk

item.title: Isle of Palms to Host Town Hall March 26
item.description: The City of Isle of Palms will host a town hall meeting on Thursday, March 26, at 5 p.m. at the Isle of Palms Recreation Center.

item.title: Sullivans Island Town Council Approves Palmetto Fort Replica on The Mound
item.description: The Sullivan’s Island Town Council voted 6-1 on Tuesday, Feb. 17, to authorize the site at Battery Capron, commonly referred to as “The Mound,” to be used by SC250 to construct a partial replica of the 1776 Battle of Sullivan’s Island fort.

item.title: Op-Ed: The Battle of Sullivan’s Island Deserves a Bigger Place in American History
item.description: The Battle of Sullivan’s Island on June 28, 1776, remains one of the most significant — and misunderstood — events in our nation’s history. Ken Burns hit the target but missed the bull’s-eye in his American Revolution documentary.
